name: Plan d'action 2035
headline: 10,000 MW
sub: Wind, plus pumped storage and new hydro
body: Hydro-Québec's build-out plan to 2035. Sets the ceiling for every tender that follows and, by extension, the size of the financing market.

name: A/O 2026-01
headline: 1,500–3,000 MW
body: Launched 10 April 2026. First-round bids close 26 February 2027. The next visible concentration of sponsor and lender activity in Quebec renewables.

name: Parcs éoliens Des Neiges
headline: 1,200 MW
body: Three 400 MW sectors, traced to an April 2022 partnership. South and Charlevoix broke ground 31 March 2026 — 114 turbines, over C$2B invested, commissioning 2027 and 2028. West sector not yet sited. Financing structure not disclosed.

name: A/O 2023-01
headline: 1,550 MW
body: Awarded at an average supply cost of 7.8¢/kWh in 2023 dollars, excluding transmission and balancing. Per-developer pricing is sealed in the Régie docket.
